## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is the best time to visit Hurghada?
A: Year-round. Best diving: March–November. Best weather: October–April.

Q: Do I need a visa for Egypt?
A: Most nationalities can obtain a visa on arrival at Hurghada or Cairo airports.

Q: Is Egypt safe for tourists?
A: Yes. Hurghada, Luxor, Cairo and major tourist areas are very safe.

Q: What currency should I bring?
A: USD, EUR, and GBP are widely accepted. Egyptian Pound (EGP) is local currency.

Q: How fast do you confirm bookings?
A: We confirm all bookings via WhatsApp within 2 hours.
